limitations: POWER wetness is a dimensionless modeled index, not volumetric soil moisture or a parcel sensor reading.
SMAP direct ingestion is not included: the tested POWER moisture alias route returned missing data.
No local BMD probe readings are included.
No measured groundwater storage or extraction is included.
Nearby fields may share identical regional values.
Scene-level cloud cover does not equal field-level cloud-mask loss.
